provenance: measured: openapi route discovery + unauthenticated GET per route; classified by response Content-Type, not by path shape
method_limits: GET routes WITH path parameters are not probed -- /org/{slug} is not linkable without inventing a value, and inventing one is how a page starts lying
services with no /openapi.json are probed on a fixed path list only; absence there is weak evidence, not proof there is no surface
probes are unauthenticated, which is what a person clicking gets; auth-required is reported as its own state rather than folded into dead
a single probe at one moment -- a scale-to-zero service can be slow on the first hit
surface_kinds: surface = open; surface-authed = a page, but behind a login
